envelope.description: deleteEntitiesForRepo carries summaries, or clears the carry

body.title: deleteEntitiesForRepo carries summaries, or clears the carry
body.summary: Add opts.carryDocSummaries to deleteEntitiesForRepo (src/db/entities.ts:567-602): when true, copy every doc_summary row of the repository's entities into doc_summary_carry inside the detachDeleteEntities before hook (the delete's own transaction), combined with the existing returnIncomingToPending hook; when absent, delete the repository's carry rows in a write transaction of deleteEntitiesForRepo's own that runs even with no entities. Return { returnedToPending, carriedDocSummaries } and update the two exact-result assertions in src/db/__tests__/entities-return-to-pending.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: With the option, every summary the delete removes is in doc_summary_carry under (repoId, entity id) after it commits, and carriedDocSummaries equals their number.
With a carry row already present for an id that also has a doc_summary row, the delete with carryDocSummaries leaves the doc_summary value in the carry; a carry row with no live summary is kept.
A failure inside the delete transaction leaves the entities, the summaries and the carry as they were.
Without the option the repository has no carry rows afterwards, also when it has no entities left.
entities-return-to-pending.test.ts passes with carriedDocSummaries: 0 in both expectations.

tests.name: src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-carry.test.ts: 'the delete with carryDocSummaries carries every summary it removes, the live value winning over an older carry row'
src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-carry.test.ts: 'a failure inside the delete transaction rolls back the carry with the delete'
src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-carry.test.ts: 'without carryDocSummaries the repository's carry rows are deleted'
src/db/__tests__/doc-summary-carry.test.ts: 'repo removal of a repository with carry rows and no entities deletes the carry rows'
